legacy.afterFooterHtml:
<script>
    /* Copy-to-clipboard for the dark info-strip cards. Falls back to
       window.location handlers if Clipboard API is unavailable. */
    document.querySelectorAll('.kc-copy').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
        var value = btn.dataset.copy || '';
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
          var prev = btn.textContent;
          btn.textContent = 'Kopiert ✓';
          btn.classList.add('is-done');
          setTimeout(function () {
            btn.textContent = prev || 'Kopieren';
            btn.classList.remove('is-done');
          }, 1600);
        } catch (err) {
          window.location.href = value.indexOf('@') > -1 ? 'mailto:' + value : 'tel:' + value.replace(/\s+/g, '');
        }
      });
    });
  </script>
  <script src="/assets/site-chrome.js" defer></script>
